name: direction_hint
description: The Direction Hint ring shows on hostile characters only while the player has a passive that uses facing (Marked Throat), and hides again when the passive is removed.

steps.name: no hint without a facing passive
Marked Throat shows the hint on the target
the ring sits under the target and its arrow points the way the target faces
steps.note: A frozen target faces right, so the arrow should point right. The ring should be sharp, about the size of the target.

steps.name: removing the passive hides the hint
